scope: Rust programming-language conferences, selected workshops, podcasts, newsletters, technical publications, and discovery routes. A researched directory, not an exhaustive or continuously monitored calendar.
selection: Organizer and publisher sources; concrete learning value for production Rust, types, infrastructure, and embedded systems. Broader engineering sources are labelled.
limits: Event status is relative to reference_date. Recheck official dates and access before making plans.
Publication observations concern the inspected listing or feed, not every distribution platform.
Linked page language does not guarantee spoken language or captions.
No recording playback, subscription delivery, ticket availability, or registration was tested.
This companion is separate from the EuroRust catalog and export manifests. Pin its Git revision and checked_on date.
